newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended stable to firmer in low volume, with activity focused on demand for a 550 million Swiss franc issue of Sept 2004 4-1/4 percent bonds by the Pfandbriefzentrale.
Turnover was quiet large in the Pfandbriefzentrale paper and the yield went from 4.25 to 4.15 percent.
Other recent issues drew little interest due to conditions that were seen as too aggressive, traders said. They said demand remained focused on longer-term bonds.
Traders said sentiment was good and expected it to remain so despite speculation of an impending U.S. interest rate hike.
Sept conf bond CONFU6 up 5 basis points at 113.65.
Sept comi medium-term bond COMIU6 up 31 at 109.90.
Sept Euro Swiss francs FESU6 up four at 97.89.
